name: China Temple Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: China Temple Mahjong is an online mahjong game. This is a classic online version of mahjong for you to play from your computer or mobile device. The tiles are set against beautiful and traditional backgrounds from China. Match two open tiles until you make them all disappear in this online mahjong game. To help you out, open tiles will appear brighter and tiles you cannot use will have a gray shadow. Try to free tiles to be able to use them and to beat the game. There are 20 levels of this mahjong game for you to solve! This is a timed game so do not hesitate and work quickly. At the end of this online game, submit your score to see if you made it to the top online players.
